page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 4 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.mn4.xlarge in the lower performance tiers. Both single-core and multi-core CPU tests, including stress-ng and Geekbench, rank in the bottom 25%. Similarly, memory bandwidth read operations for both small and large blocks are weak, though large block write performance reaches average levels. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, register in the bottom 10%. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also constrained, reflecting the shared CPU allocation model.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest performance profile, the ecs.mn4.xlarge offers a budget-friendly option for workloads that do not require sustained high-performance compute resources. It is best suited for low-traffic web serving, basic development or testing environments, light background tasks, and small-scale applications where resource density and cost efficiency are prioritized over raw processing speed.
